lines.text: Paul does not want believers to grieve like those without hope, since Jesus died and rose again.
The Lord will descend from heaven with the voice of an archangel and the trumpet of God, and the living will be first to rise.
Believers who are alive will be caught up in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air and always be with Him.
The Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night, and sudden rescue will come upon those saying "Peace and security."
Believers are to put on the breastplate of faith and love and the helmet of the hope of salvation.
